findings.title: [P2] Retire Gateway speech when the TTS permission is revoked
findings.body:
permission-and-voice-consent-integration:

Turning off Text-to-speech in Permissions persists `NodeTtsEnabled = false`, but this save handler returns whenever `UseGatewayVoice` is unchanged. An admitted Gateway preview or automatic response therefore remains active: if it is awaiting status, it can still submit `tts.speak` after revocation; if synthesis or playback is underway, the returned audio can continue playing. The admission checks in App and the preview button only check permission before starting. Track TTS permission changes here and cancel active delegated speech when permission is removed, with a permission check before synthesis admission.
